---
title: "02c - Soil organic carbon (SOC) by plot and age"
output: html_document
---

**Purpose.** Computes soil organic carbon (SOC) stock and SOC change per plot
and stand age from the measurements table of the GROA-AF dataset. For each
plot, SOC is summed across depth strata and harmonized to common depths
(15, 30, and 60 cm) using the Jobbágy & Jackson cumulative depth distribution.
The selected depth (`c_varname`, 30 cm by default) is then compared with the
reference/control values for each soil comparison design (plot/site/study
reference, chronosequence, and plot change with site reference) to get the
carbon difference (delta) and the annual rate of change. Records whose
soil comparison design is recorded as `SOC_change` (change rates reported
directly by the source study) do not match any of these designs and are
therefore not included in the output.

**Inputs.**

- `data/groa_af/measurements.csv` (GROA-AF dataset)

**Outputs.**

- `output/intermediate/soc_dep_sum.xlsx`: SOC summed over depth strata per
  plot and age, with 15/30/60 cm normalized values (re-loaded in this notebook)
- `output/intermediate/soc_data_out_<c_varname>.xlsx`: SOC stock and change
  per plot and age. Downstream notebooks (03a, 03b, 10) use
  `soc_data_out_c_t_ha_norm_30.xlsx`.

```{r setup}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)

```

Analysis options: reference vs. agroforestry categories, the normalized depth stratum to analyze, and the k value for depth normalization.
```{r options}

ref_cats <- c('CROP', 'GRA', 'OTH_CTR')

af_cats <- c('AC', 'BP', 'COP', 'FAL', 'FOD', 'MS', 'OTH_AF', 'PAR', 'RB', 'ROT', 'SA', 'SP', 'SPC', 'TMC', 'WL')

# select normalized depth stratum to analyze
c_varname <- 'c_t_ha_norm_30'

# k value for Jobbagy equation
k_value <- 2.0 # typical value from literature

```

Helper functions to parse numeric strings and ranges (e.g. "10 to 20"), soil depth strings, and comma-separated lists.
```{r helpers}
parse_num <- function (num_str) {
  num_str <- num_str %>% str_remove('<') %>% str_remove('>')
  if (is.na(num_str) || num_str == '') {
    return(NA)
  } else if (!is.na(as.numeric(num_str))) {
    return(as.numeric(num_str))
  } else if (grepl('to', num_str)) {
    num_strs <- num_str %>%
      str_split_1('to') %>%
      trimws()
    return(mean(c(as.numeric(num_strs[1]), as.numeric(num_strs[2]))))
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

parse_depth <- function (dep_str) {
  if (grepl('to', dep_str)) {
    dep_strs <- dep_str %>%
      str_split_1('to') %>%
      trimws()
    return(c(as.numeric(dep_strs[1]), as.numeric(dep_strs[2])))
  }
  else {
    return(c(NA, NA))
  }
}

# function to compile comma-separated lists of data for output
make_csl <- function(vec) {
  csl_all <- paste0(vec, collapse = ', ')
  vec <- str_split_1(csl_all, pattern = ', ') %>%
    trimws() %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  return (paste0(vec, collapse = ', '))
}

```


Load SOC and SOC change measurements from the measurements table.
```{r load-s3}

s3_df <- read.csv(here("data", "groa_af", "measurements.csv"),
                  colClasses = "character", na.strings = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM") %>%
  select(measurement_id, study_id, site_id, plot_id, af_cat, measurement_year, age_yrs, variable_name, c_pool, c_t_ha, soil_depth_cm, soil_comparison) %>%
  filter(!(c_t_ha == '' | is.na(c_t_ha))) %>%
  mutate(ssp_id = paste0(study_id, ';', site_id, ';', plot_id)) %>%
  filter(c_pool %in% c("SOC", "SOC_change")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(soil_depth_cm))

```


Convert age.yrs and c_t_ha to numeric and parse soil depth into min and max columns.
```{r parse-cols}
s3_df <- s3_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(age_yrs = parse_num(age_yrs)) %>%
  mutate(c_t_ha = parse_num(c_t_ha)) %>%
  mutate(c_t_ha = as.numeric(c_t_ha)) %>%
  mutate(depth_min = parse_depth(soil_depth_cm)[1]) %>%
  mutate(depth_max = parse_depth(soil_depth_cm)[2])

```

Functions to normalize SOC to a target depth (Jobbágy & Jackson cumulative depth distribution).
```{r depth-norm-fns}

# function to estimate cumulative SOC fraction at depth z (from Jobbagy)
# k = 2 is the standard value for the curve shape
soc_fraction <- function(z, k = 2) {
  1 - exp(-k * z)
}

# function to standardize SOC to a given depth
normalize_soc <- function(soc_measured, depth_measured_m, 
                          target_depth_m, k = 2) {
  f_measured <- soc_fraction(depth_measured_m, k)
  f_target <- soc_fraction(target_depth_m, k)
  soc_normalized <- soc_measured * (f_target / f_measured)
  return(soc_normalized)
}

```


For each plot, af.cat, and age, sum SOC across depth strata (dropping overlapping strata and handling discontinuous ones) and normalize to 15, 30, and 60 cm. Results are saved to `soc_dep_sum.xlsx`.
```{r sum-depth-strata}

# copy of s3_df but empty
s3_df_dep_sum <- s3_df[0, ] %>% mutate(dep_flag = '') 

ssp_ids <- s3_df %>% pull(ssp_id) %>% unique()

for (i in 1:length(ssp_ids)) {
  if (i %% 1000 == 1) {
    print(paste("Summing depth strata, plots", i, '-', min(length(ssp_ids), i+999),
                'of', length(ssp_ids)))
  }
  
  pid <- ssp_ids[i]
  
  
  plot_dat <- s3_df %>% 
    filter(ssp_id == pid) %>%
    mutate(age_yrs = replace_na(age_yrs, 9999))
  
  # if plot_dat contains multiple measurement types, select only one,
  # to avoid double-counting.  prioritization order = SOC, SOM, soil_perC, SOM_per
  if ('SOC' %in% plot_dat$variable_name) {
    plot_dat <- plot_dat %>% filter(variable_name == 'SOC')
  }
  if ('SOM' %in% plot_dat$variable_name) {
    plot_dat <- plot_dat %>% filter(variable_name == 'SOM')
  }
  if ('soil_perC' %in% plot_dat$variable_name) {
    plot_dat <- plot_dat %>% filter(variable_name == 'soil_perC')
  }
  if ('SOM_per' %in% plot_dat$variable_name) {
    plot_dat <- plot_dat %>% filter(variable_name == 'SOM_per')
  }
  
  
  # first do C
  plot_dat_c <- plot_dat %>% 
    filter(c_pool == "SOC")
  
  dep_flag <- ''
  
  for (my_af_cat in plot_dat_c$af_cat %>% unique()) {
    
    rep_age_date <- F
    # for plot_change/site_ref, reference categories, we need to break 
    # the data out by year (proxy for age).  we'll encode age as year, and then
    # reset it at the end
    if (('plot_change/site_ref' %in% (plot_dat_c %>%
                                      filter(af_cat == my_af_cat) %>%
                                      pull(soil_comparison) %>%
                                      unique())) &&
        (my_af_cat %in% ref_cats) &&
        (plot_dat_c %>%
         filter(af_cat == my_af_cat) %>%
         pull(measurement_year) %>%
         unique() %>%
         length() > 1)) {
      rep_age_date <- T
      plot_dat_c <- plot_dat_c %>%
        mutate(age_yrs = ifelse(soil_comparison == 'plot_change/site_ref', as.numeric(measurement_year), age_yrs))
    }
    
    for (age in plot_dat_c$age_yrs %>% unique()) {
      plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_c %>%
        filter(af_cat == my_af_cat,
               age_yrs == age) 
      
      # record measurement_id for later, then remove it from df
      my_measurement_ids <- paste0(plot_dat_filt$measurement_id %>% unique(), collapse = ', ')
      plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>% select(-measurement_id)
      
      # record date(s) for later, then remove it from df
      my_dates <- paste0(plot_dat_filt$measurement_year %>% unique(), collapse = ', ')
      plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>% select(-measurement_year)
      
      # record soil_comparison for later, then remove it from df
      soil_comp <- plot_dat_filt$soil_comparison %>% unique() %>% na.omit()
      plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>% select(-soil_comparison)
      if (length(soil_comp) > 1) {soil_comp <- 'CHECK_multi_soil_comp'}
      
      # if there are different particle sizes (denoted by mm or um), 
      # need to first summarize by adding those together
      if (nrow(plot_dat_filt %>% filter(grepl('mm|um', variable_name))) > 1) {
        plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>%
          group_by(soil_depth_cm) %>%
          mutate(c_t_ha = sum(c_t_ha)) %>%
          mutate(variable_name = 'SOC') %>%
          unique()
      }
      
      # if there are multiple measurements for the same depth stratum,
      # average them
      plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>%
        group_by(soil_depth_cm) %>%
        mutate(c_t_ha = mean(c_t_ha)) %>%
        unique()
      
      if (nrow(plot_dat_filt > 0)) {
        
        # if there are multiple depth strata, check that they do not overlap
        # drop strata completely contained within another stratum
        if (length(plot_dat_filt$soil_depth_cm %>% unique()) > 1) {
          overlapping_strata <- c()
          strats <- plot_dat_filt$soil_depth_cm %>% unique()
          for (strat in strats) {
            min <- plot_dat_filt %>% filter(soil_depth_cm == strat) %>% pull(depth_min)
            max <- plot_dat_filt %>% filter(soil_depth_cm == strat) %>% pull(depth_max)
            for (oth_strat in strats[strats != strat]) {
              oth_min <- plot_dat_filt %>% filter(soil_depth_cm == oth_strat) %>% pull(depth_min)
              oth_max <- plot_dat_filt %>% filter(soil_depth_cm == oth_strat) %>% pull(depth_max)
              if (min <= oth_min && max >= oth_max) {
                overlapping_strata <- c(overlapping_strata, oth_strat)
              }
            }
          }
          overlapping_strata <- overlapping_strata %>% unique()
          plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>% filter(!soil_depth_cm %in% overlapping_strata)
        }
        
        # if there are still multiple depth strata, check that they are continuous
        # (1 apart also acceptable, e.g. 0-10, 11-20, 21-30)
        if (length(plot_dat_filt$soil_depth_cm %>% unique()) > 1) {
          depth_mins <- plot_dat_filt$depth_min %>% sort()
          depth_maxs <- plot_dat_filt$depth_max %>% sort()
          if (abs(sum(head(depth_maxs, -1) - tail(depth_mins, -1))) >= 
              nrow(plot_dat_filt)) {
            # if depths are discontinuous, choose stratum closest to surface
            plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>%
              filter(depth_min == depth_mins[1],
                     depth_max == depth_maxs[1])
          }
        }
        
        depth_min <- min(plot_dat_filt$depth_min)
        depth_max <- max(plot_dat_filt$depth_max)
        c_t_ha_sum <- sum(plot_dat_filt$c_t_ha)
        
        if (age == 9999) {age <- NA}
        if (rep_age_date) {age <- NA}
        
        my_study_id <- plot_dat_filt$study_id %>% unique()
        if (length(my_study_id) > 1) {my_study_id <- 'CHECK_multi_study_id'}
        
        my_site_id <- plot_dat_filt$site_id %>% unique()
        if (length(my_site_id) > 1) {my_site_id <- 'CHECK_multi_site_id'}
        
        my_plot_id <- plot_dat_filt$plot_id %>% unique()
        if (length(my_plot_id) > 1) {my_plot_id <- 'CHECK_multi_plot_id'}
        
        var_cat_c <- plot_dat_filt$c_pool %>% unique()
        if (length(var_cat_c) > 1) {var_cat_c <- 'CHECK_multi_var_cat_c'}
        
        
        # calculate depth-normalized C
        
        # if min depth is very near surface (<=2cm), we'll assume it's 0
        if (depth_min <= 2) {depth_min <- 0}
        
        # init output vars to NA
        soc_normalized_15 <- NA
        soc_normalized_30 <- NA
        soc_normalized_60 <- NA
        
        # must start with surface
        if (!depth_min == 0) {
          dep_flag <- 'min_depth_not_0'
        } else {
          # calculate each normalized depth strata only if measurement depth is
          # sufficient that we can reasonably extrapolate (must be >= 1/3 x norm depth)
          if (depth_max >= 5) {
            soc_normalized_15 <- normalize_soc(soc_measured = c_t_ha_sum,
                                               depth_measured_m = depth_max/100,
                                               target_depth_m = 0.15,
                                               k = k_value)
          }
          if (depth_max >= 10) {
            soc_normalized_30 <- normalize_soc(soc_measured = c_t_ha_sum,
                                               depth_measured_m = depth_max/100,
                                               target_depth_m = 0.3,
                                               k = k_value)
          }
          if (depth_max >= 20) {
            soc_normalized_60 <- normalize_soc(soc_measured = c_t_ha_sum,
                                               depth_measured_m = depth_max/100,
                                               target_depth_m = 0.6,
                                               k = k_value)
          }
        }
        
        s3_df_dep_sum <- s3_df_dep_sum %>% 
          bind_rows(tibble(measurement_id = my_measurement_ids,
                           study_id = my_study_id,
                           site_id = my_site_id,
                           plot_id = my_plot_id,
                           ssp_id = pid,
                           af_cat = my_af_cat,
                           measurement_year = my_dates,
                           age_yrs = age,
                           c_pool = var_cat_c,
                           c_t_ha = c_t_ha_sum,
                           c_t_ha_norm_15 = soc_normalized_15,
                           c_t_ha_norm_30 = soc_normalized_30,
                           c_t_ha_norm_60 = soc_normalized_60,
                           soil_comparison = soil_comp,
                           depth_min = depth_min,
                           depth_max = depth_max,
                           dep_flag = dep_flag)
          )
      }
    }
  }
  
  
  # then do C change
  plot_dat_c_change <- plot_dat %>% 
    filter(c_pool == "SOC_change")
  
  dep_flag <- ''
  
  for (my_af_cat in plot_dat_c_change$af_cat %>% unique()) {
    
    rep_age_date <- F
    # for plot_change/site_ref, reference categories, we need to break 
    # the data out by year (proxy for age).  we'll encode age as year, and then
    # reset it at the end
    if (('plot_change/site_ref' %in% (plot_dat_c_change %>%
                                      filter(af_cat == my_af_cat) %>%
                                      pull(soil_comparison) %>%
                                      unique())) &&
        (my_af_cat %in% ref_cats) &&
        (plot_dat_c_change %>%
         filter(af_cat == my_af_cat) %>%
         pull(measurement_year) %>%
         unique() %>%
         length() > 1)) {
      rep_age_date <- T
      plot_dat_c_change <- plot_dat_c_change %>%
        mutate(age_yrs = ifelse(soil_comparison == 'plot_change/site_ref', as.numeric(measurement_year), age_yrs))
    }
    
    for (age in plot_dat_c_change$age_yrs %>% unique()) {
      plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_c_change %>%
        filter(af_cat == my_af_cat,
               age_yrs == age) 
      
      # record measurement_id for later, then remove it from df
      my_measurement_ids <- paste0(plot_dat_filt$measurement_id %>% unique(), collapse = ', ')
      plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>% select(-measurement_id)
      
      # record date(s) for later, then remove date from df
      my_dates <- paste0(plot_dat_filt$measurement_year %>% unique(), collapse = ', ')
      plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>% select(-measurement_year)
      
      # record soil_comparison for later, then remove date from df
      soil_comp <- plot_dat_filt$soil_comparison %>% unique() %>% na.omit()
      plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>% select(-soil_comparison)
      if (length(soil_comp) > 1) {soil_comp <- 'CHECK_multi_soil_comp'}
      
      # if there are different particle sizes (denoted by mm or um), 
      # need to first summarize by adding those together
      if (nrow(plot_dat_filt %>% filter(grepl('mm|um', variable_name))) > 1) {
        plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>%
          group_by(soil_depth_cm) %>%
          mutate(c_t_ha = sum(c_t_ha)) %>%
          mutate(variable_name = 'SOC') %>%
          unique()
      }
      
      # if there are multiple measurements for the same depth stratum,
      # average them
      plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>%
        group_by(soil_depth_cm) %>%
        mutate(c_t_ha = mean(c_t_ha)) %>%
        unique()
      
      if (nrow(plot_dat_filt > 0)) {
        
        # if there are multiple depth strata, check that they do not overlap
        # drop strata completely contained within another stratum
        if (length(plot_dat_filt$soil_depth_cm %>% unique()) > 1) {
          overlapping_strata <- c()
          strats <- plot_dat_filt$soil_depth_cm %>% unique()
          for (strat in strats) {
            min <- plot_dat_filt %>% filter(soil_depth_cm == strat) %>% pull(depth_min)
            max <- plot_dat_filt %>% filter(soil_depth_cm == strat) %>% pull(depth_max)
            for (oth_strat in strats[strats != strat]) {
              oth_min <- plot_dat_filt %>% filter(soil_depth_cm == oth_strat) %>% pull(depth_min)
              oth_max <- plot_dat_filt %>% filter(soil_depth_cm == oth_strat) %>% pull(depth_max)
              if (min <= oth_min && max >= oth_max) {
                overlapping_strata <- c(overlapping_strata, oth_strat)
              }
            }
          }
          overlapping_strata <- overlapping_strata %>% unique()
          plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>% filter(!soil_depth_cm %in% overlapping_strata)
        }
        
        # if there are still multiple depth strata, check that they are continuous
        # (1 apart also acceptable, e.g. 0-10, 11-20, 21-30)
        if (length(plot_dat_filt$soil_depth_cm %>% unique()) > 1) {
          depth_mins <- plot_dat_filt$depth_min %>% sort()
          depth_maxs <- plot_dat_filt$depth_max %>% sort()
          if (abs(sum(head(depth_maxs, -1) - tail(depth_mins, -1))) >= 
              nrow(plot_dat_filt)) {
            # if depths are discontinuous, choose stratum closest to surface
            plot_dat_filt <- plot_dat_filt %>%
              filter(depth_min == depth_mins[1],
                     depth_max == depth_maxs[1])
          }
        }
        
        depth_min <- min(plot_dat_filt$depth_min)
        depth_max <- max(plot_dat_filt$depth_max)
        c_t_ha_sum <- sum(plot_dat_filt$c_t_ha)
        
        if (age == 9999) {age <- NA}
        if (rep_age_date) {age <- NA}
        
        my_study_id = plot_dat_filt$study_id %>% unique()
        if (length(my_study_id) > 1) {my_study_id <- 'CHECK_multi_study_id'}
        
        my_site_id = plot_dat_filt$site_id %>% unique()
        if (length(my_site_id) > 1) {my_site_id <- 'CHECK_multi_site_id'}
        
        my_plot_id = plot_dat_filt$plot_id %>% unique()
        if (length(my_plot_id) > 1) {my_plot_id <- 'CHECK_multi_plot_id'}
        
        var_cat_c = plot_dat_filt$c_pool %>% unique()
        if (length(var_cat_c) > 1) {var_cat_c <- 'CHECK_multi_var_cat_c'}
        
        
        # calculate depth-normalized C
        
        # if min depth is very near surface (<=2cm), we'll assume it's 0
        if (depth_min <= 2) {depth_min <- 0}
        
        # init output vars to NA
        soc_normalized_15 <- NA
        soc_normalized_30 <- NA
        soc_normalized_60 <- NA
        
        # must start with surface
        if (!depth_min == 0) {
          dep_flag <- 'min_depth_not_0'
        } else {
          # calculate each normalized depth strata only if measurement depth is
          # sufficient that we can reasonably extrapolate (must be >= .5 x norm depth)
          if (depth_max >= 7.5) {
            soc_normalized_15 <- normalize_soc(soc_measured = c_t_ha_sum,
                                               depth_measured_m = depth_max/100,
                                               target_depth_m = 0.15,
                                               k = k_value)
          }
          if (depth_max >= 15) {
            soc_normalized_30 <- normalize_soc(soc_measured = c_t_ha_sum,
                                               depth_measured_m = depth_max/100,
                                               target_depth_m = 0.3,
                                               k = k_value)
          }
          if (depth_max >= 30) {
            soc_normalized_60 <- normalize_soc(soc_measured = c_t_ha_sum,
                                               depth_measured_m = depth_max/100,
                                               target_depth_m = 0.6,
                                               k = k_value)
          }
        }
        
        s3_df_dep_sum <- s3_df_dep_sum %>% 
          bind_rows(tibble(measurement_id = my_measurement_ids,
                           study_id = my_study_id,
                           site_id = my_site_id,
                           plot_id = my_plot_id,
                           ssp_id = pid,
                           af_cat = my_af_cat,
                           measurement_year = my_dates,
                           age_yrs = age,
                           c_pool = var_cat_c,
                           c_t_ha = c_t_ha_sum,
                           c_t_ha_norm_15 = soc_normalized_15,
                           c_t_ha_norm_30 = soc_normalized_30,
                           c_t_ha_norm_60 = soc_normalized_60,
                           soil_comparison = soil_comp,
                           depth_min = depth_min,
                           depth_max = depth_max,
                           dep_flag = dep_flag)
          )
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Re-load the depth sums, keep the normalized depth stratum of interest as `c_t_ha` (dropping the other strata), and drop rows with no value.
```{r reload-dep-sum}

s3_df_dep_sum <- read.xlsx(here("output", "intermediate", "soc_dep_sum.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(c_t_ha = !!sym(c_varname)) %>%
  select(-c_t_ha_norm_15, -c_t_ha_norm_30, -c_t_ha_norm_60) %>%
  filter(!is.na(c_t_ha))

```


Split rows with multiple plot IDs (e.g. "1/2" or "1, 2") into a separate df; these are matched back to single plots later.
```{r split-multiplot}

s3_df_dep_sum_multiplot <- s3_df_dep_sum %>%
  filter(grepl('/|,', plot_id))

s3_df_dep_sum <- s3_df_dep_sum %>%
  filter(!grepl('/|,', plot_id))

```


# Parse each plot and compute c based on soil.comp

Empty output table for per-plot carbon stock and change.
```{r c-df-setup}
c_df <- tibble(measurement_id = character(), study_id = character(), site_id = character(), 
               plot_id = character(), ssp_id = character(), c_pool = character(),
               measurement_year = character(), age_yrs = numeric(), age_yrs_prev_chron = numeric(),
               af_cat = character(), ctrl_cat = character(), 
               depth_min = numeric(), depth_max = numeric(), dep_flag = character(),
               depth_min_ctrl = numeric(), depth_max_ctrl = numeric(), dep_mismatch_flag = character(),
               soil_comparison = character(), sc_flag = character(),
               c_t_ha_af = numeric(), c_t_ha_ctrl = numeric(), ctrl_type = character(), 
               c_t_ha_af_prev_chron = numeric(), c_t_ha_ctrl_prev_chron = numeric(),
               c_t_ha_diff_prev_chron = numeric(),
               c_t_ha_yr = numeric(), c_t_ha_delta = numeric())

```


Function to calculate soil comp for plot_ref, site_ref, study_ref designs: compare each row with the reference category (or age 0) at the plot, site, or study level.
```{r fn-sc-ref}

sc_ref <- function (row_dat, comp_df) {
  
  sc_flag <- ''
  multi_ref <- F
  
  # find all possible refs in study_df
  # search for either a reference cat, or the same cat with age == 0
  ref_dat <- comp_df %>% filter(af_cat %in% ref_cats | (af_cat == row_dat$af_cat & age_yrs == 0))
  # if there is more than one row, set multi_ref flag
  if (nrow(ref_dat) > 1) {multi_ref <- T}
  # if there are 0 rows, set no_ref flag
  if (nrow(ref_dat) == 0) {sc_flag = 'no_ref'}
  
  if (sc_flag == 'no_ref') {
    my_ctrl_cat <- NA
    depth_min_ctrl <- NA
    depth_max_ctrl <- NA
    c_t_ha_ctrl <- NA
  } else if (multi_ref) {
    ctrl_cats <- ref_dat$af_cat %>% unique()
    if (length(ctrl_cats) == 1) {
      my_ctrl_cat <- ctrl_cats
    } else {
      my_ctrl_cat <- paste0(ctrl_cats, collapse = ', ')
    }
    depth_min_ctrl <- min(ref_dat$depth_min)
    depth_max_ctrl <- max(ref_dat$depth_max)
    c_t_ha_ctrl <- mean(ref_dat$c_t_ha)
  } else { # just one reference
    my_ctrl_cat <- ref_dat$af_cat
    depth_min_ctrl <- min(ref_dat$depth_min)
    depth_max_ctrl <- max(ref_dat$depth_max)
    c_t_ha_ctrl <- ref_dat$c_t_ha
  }
  
  if (row_dat$c_pool == 'SOC') {
    c_t_ha_af <- row_dat$c_t_ha
    c_t_ha_diff <- row_dat$c_t_ha - c_t_ha_ctrl
    c_t_ha_yr <- c_t_ha_diff / row_dat$age_yrs
  } else if (row_dat$c_pool == 'SOC_change') {
    c_t_ha_af <- c_t_ha_ctrl + (row_dat$c_t_ha * row_dat$age_yrs)
    c_t_ha_diff <- c_t_ha_af - c_t_ha_ctrl
    c_t_ha_yr <- row_dat$c_t_ha
  }
  
  return (list(my_ctrl_cat = my_ctrl_cat,
               depth_min_ctrl = depth_min_ctrl,
               depth_max_ctrl = depth_max_ctrl,
               c_t_ha_ctrl = c_t_ha_ctrl,
               c_t_ha_af = c_t_ha_af,
               c_t_ha_yr = c_t_ha_yr,
               sc_flag = sc_flag))
  
}

```

Function to calculate soil comp for plot_change, site_chrono, study_chrono designs: compute change between consecutive ages (or dates) in the time series, and extrapolate a t0 control by linear regression where possible.
```{r fn-sc-chrono}

sc_chrono <- function(in_df, sc_lab) {
  
  # if there is no age 0, look back at the proper level (plot, site, or 
  # study).  if there are ref cats with no associated age, assume they are 0
  if (!0 %in% in_df$age_yrs) {
    in_df <- in_df %>% 
      mutate(soil_comparison = ifelse(af_cat %in% ref_cats & is.na(age_yrs), sc_lab, soil_comparison)) %>%
      mutate(age_yrs = ifelse(af_cat %in% ref_cats & is.na(age_yrs), 0, age_yrs))
  }
  
  in_df <- in_df %>% 
    filter(soil_comparison == sc_lab) %>%
    arrange(age_yrs)
  
  # there could be multiple af_cats in one study/site
  # run the analysis for each non-ref af_cat
  # if there is only one row for a given cat, set sc_flag
  
  my_nonref_cats <- in_df %>%
    filter(grepl(paste(af_cats, collapse = "|"), af_cat)) %>%
    filter(age_yrs > 0) %>%
    pull(af_cat) %>%
    unique()
  
  
  out_df <- c_df[0,]
  
  for (cat in my_nonref_cats) {
    sc_flag <- ''
    # filter to cat of interest, and also include reference cats (for age 0)
    df <- in_df %>% filter(af_cat == cat | af_cat %in% ref_cats | age_yrs == 0)
    if (nrow(df) == 1) {
      out_row <- df %>%
        rename(c_t_ha_af = c_t_ha)
      out_row$sc_flag <- 'invalid_age_reference_this_af.cat'
      out_df <- out_df %>% bind_rows(out_row)
      
    } else {
      
      use_date <- F
      
      # if there are not a complete set of ages, but there are a complete set of
      # dates, use date to calculate change
      if (NA %in% df$age_yrs &&
          !NA %in% df$measurement_year && 
          length(df$measurement_year %>% unique()) == nrow(df)) {
        use_date <- T
        df <- df %>%
          rowwise() %>%
          mutate(measurement_year = parse_num(measurement_year)) %>% 
          arrange(measurement_year)
        date_vals <- df$measurement_year %>% unique()
        df <- df %>%
          mutate(measurement_year = as.character(measurement_year))
        # if there are NAs in age_yrs, but removing them still leaves at least two
        # rows, we can remove the NAs and proceed
      } else if (NA %in% df$age_yrs &&
                 nrow(df %>% filter(!is.na(age_yrs))) >= 2) {
        df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(age_yrs))
      }
      # guard against invalid timeseries in both date AND age
      if (((!use_date) && NA %in% df$age_yrs) ||
          (use_date && NA %in% df$measurement_year)) {
        df <- df %>% filter(af_cat == cat)
        out_row <- df %>%
          rename(c_t_ha_af = c_t_ha)
        out_row$sc_flag <- 'invalid_age_reference_this_af.cat'
        out_df <- out_df %>% bind_rows(out_row)
      } else {
        
        age_vals <- df$age_yrs %>% unique()
        
        # if there are multiple rows with the same age (or date if use_date), 
        # average c_t_ha vals and combine others:
        # numeric should be the same, character columns using make_csl function
        
        df_comb <- df[0,]
        if (!use_date) {
          for (age_val in age_vals) {
            age_df <- df %>%
              filter(age_yrs == age_val)
            if (nrow(age_df) == 1) {
              df_comb <- df_comb %>%
                bind_rows(age_df)
            } else {
              age_df_comb <- age_df[1,]
              for (col in names(df %>% select_if(is.character))) {
                age_df_comb[[1,col]] <- make_csl(age_df[[col]])
              }
              age_df_comb$c_t_ha <- mean(age_df$c_t_ha)
              df_comb <- df_comb %>%
                bind_rows(age_df_comb)
            }
          } 
        } else {
          for (date_val in date_vals) {
            date_df <- df %>%
              filter(measurement_year == date_val)
            if (nrow(date_df) == 1) {
              df_comb <- df_comb %>%
                bind_rows(date_df)
            } else {
              date_df_comb <- date_df[1,]
              for (col in names(df %>% select_if(is.character))) {
                date_df_comb[[1,col]] <- make_csl(date_df[[col]])
              }
              date_df_comb$c_t_ha <- mean(date_df$c_t_ha)
              df_comb <- df_comb %>%
                bind_rows(date_df_comb)
            }
          }
        }
        
        # fit line to find extrapolated t0 control
        c_t_ha_ctrl_extrap <- NA
        if (!use_date) {
          lm_df <- df_comb %>%
            filter(!is.na(age_yrs), !is.na(c_t_ha))
          
          if (nrow(lm_df) >= 3 && # must have at least 3 values in chronosequnce
              length(unique(lm_df$age_yrs)) >= 2) { # must have at least 2 unique values
            lm_fit <- lm(c_t_ha ~ age_yrs, data = lm_df)
            c_t_ha_ctrl_extrap <- coef(lm_fit)[["(Intercept)"]]
          } else {
            sc_flag <- 'insuff_vals_chrono_extrap_ctrl'
          }
        } 
        # set flag if extrapolated value is negative and coerce c_t_ha_ctrl to NA
        if (!is.na(c_t_ha_ctrl_extrap) && c_t_ha_ctrl_extrap < 0) {
          c_t_ha_ctrl_extrap <- NA
          sc_flag <- "neg_extrap_ctrl"
        }


        for (i in 2:nrow(df_comb)) {
          comp_df <- df_comb[c(i-1, i),]
          out_row <- df_comb[i,] %>% select(-c_t_ha)
          out_row$measurement_id <- make_csl(comp_df$measurement_id)
          out_row$plot_id <- make_csl(comp_df$plot_id)
          out_row$ssp_id <- make_csl(comp_df$ssp_id)
          out_row$measurement_year <- make_csl(comp_df$measurement_year)
          
          out_row$age_yrs <- comp_df$age_yrs[2]
          out_row$age_yrs_prev_chron <- comp_df$age_yrs[1]

          out_row$sc_flag <- sc_flag
          
          out_row$c_t_ha_af <- comp_df$c_t_ha[2]
          out_row$c_t_ha_af_prev_chron <- comp_df$c_t_ha[1]
          out_row$c_t_ha_diff_prev_chron <- out_row$c_t_ha_af - out_row$c_t_ha_af_prev_chron
          
          # set control values if there is an age 0 or one of the af.cats is in ref_cats
          if (0 %in% df_comb$age_yrs ||
              sum(grepl(paste0(ref_cats, collapse = '|'), df_comb %>% pull(af_cat))) > 1) {
            ctrl_df <- df_comb %>% 
              filter(age_yrs == 0 |
                       grepl(paste0(ref_cats, collapse = '|'), af_cat))
            if(nrow(ctrl_df) > 1) {
              sc_flag <- 'multi_ctrl'
            } else {
              out_row$ctrl_cat <- ctrl_df$af_cat
              out_row$depth_min_ctrl <- ctrl_df$depth_min
              out_row$depth_max_ctrl <- ctrl_df$depth_max
              out_row$c_t_ha_ctrl <- ctrl_df$c_t_ha
            }
          }
          
          out_row$c_t_ha_ctrl_extrap <- round(c_t_ha_ctrl_extrap, 3)

          if (use_date) {
            yrs_diff_prev_chron <- comp_df$measurement_year[2] - comp_df$measurement_year[1]
          } else {yrs_diff_prev_chron <- comp_df$age_yrs[2] - comp_df$age_yrs[1]}
          
          out_row$c_t_ha_yr <- out_row$c_t_ha_diff_prev_chron / yrs_diff_prev_chron
          
          out_df <- out_df %>% bind_rows(out_row)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return (out_df)
}

```

Function to calculate soil comp for plot_change/site_ref designs: the change in the agroforestry plot between two dates minus the change in the site reference over the same dates.
```{r fn-sc-pcsr}

sc_pcsr <- function(in_df, sc_lab) {
  
  in_df <- in_df %>% 
    filter(soil_comparison == sc_lab) %>%
    arrange(age_yrs)
  
  comp_df <- s3_df_dep_sum %>%
    filter(site_id == in_df$site_id %>% unique(),
           study_id == in_df$study_id %>% unique(),
           af_cat %in% ref_cats)
  
  in_df_comb <- in_df[0,]
  comp_df_comb <- in_df[0,]
  out_df <- c_df[0,]
  
  sc_flag <- ''
  
  
  # if there are multiple rows with the same date, 
  # average c_t_ha vals and combine others:
  # numeric should be the same, character columns using make_csl function
  # if there's just one row, need to copy in_df to in_df_comb for output
  if (nrow(in_df) < 2) {
    in_df_comb <- in_df
  } else {
    for (date_val in in_df$measurement_year %>% unique()) {
      date_df <- in_df %>%
        filter(measurement_year == date_val)
      if (nrow(date_df) == 1) {
        in_df_comb <- in_df_comb %>%
          bind_rows(date_df)
      } else {
        date_df_comb <- date_df[1,]
        for (col in names(in_df %>% select_if(is.character))) {
          date_df_comb[[1,col]] <- make_csl(date_df[[col]])
        }
        date_df_comb$c_t_ha <- mean(date_df$c_t_ha)
        in_df_comb <- in_df_comb %>%
          bind_rows(date_df_comb)
      }
    }
  }
  # do the same for comp_df
  if (nrow(comp_df) < 2) {
    comp_df_comb <- comp_df
  } else {
    for (date_val in comp_df$measurement_year %>% unique()) {
      date_df <- comp_df %>%
        filter(measurement_year == date_val)
      if (nrow(date_df) == 1) {
        comp_df_comb <- comp_df_comb %>%
          bind_rows(date_df)
      } else {
        date_df_comb <- date_df[1,]
        for (col in names(comp_df %>% select_if(is.character))) {
          date_df_comb[[1,col]] <- make_csl(date_df[[col]])
        }
        date_df_comb$c_t_ha <- mean(date_df$c_t_ha)
        comp_df_comb <- comp_df_comb %>%
          bind_rows(date_df_comb)
      }
    }
  }
  
  in_df_comb <- in_df_comb %>% arrange(measurement_year)
  comp_df_comb <- comp_df_comb %>% arrange(measurement_year)
  
  if (!all(in_df_comb$measurement_year %>% unique() %in% comp_df_comb$measurement_year %>% unique())) {
    sc_flag <- 'pc/sr_comp_date_mismatch'
  }
  
  # if there are less than 2 rows in in_df_comb, can't compute sc
  if (nrow(in_df_comb) < 2) {
    sc_flag <- 'insufficient_rows_for_pc/sr'
    out_row <- in_df_comb[1,] %>% rename(c_t_ha_af = c_t_ha)
    out_row$sc_flag <- sc_flag
    return(out_row)
    
  } else {
    
    for (i in 2:nrow(in_df_comb)) {
      
      in_df_filt <- in_df_comb[c(i - 1, i),]
      comp_df_filt <- comp_df_comb %>% 
        filter(measurement_year %in% in_df_filt$measurement_year)
      
      if (nrow(in_df_filt) != nrow(comp_df_filt)) {
        sc_flag <- 'pc/sr_date_match_missing'
      }
      
      in_comp_df_filt <- in_df_filt %>% bind_rows(comp_df_filt)
      
      out_row <- in_df_comb[i,] %>% select(-c_t_ha)
      
      out_row$measurement_id <- make_csl(in_comp_df_filt$measurement_id)
      out_row$plot_id <- make_csl(in_comp_df_filt$plot_id)
      out_row$ssp_id <- make_csl(in_comp_df_filt$ssp_id)
      out_row$measurement_year <- make_csl(in_comp_df_filt$measurement_year)
      
      out_row$age_yrs <- in_df_filt$age_yrs[2]
      out_row$age_yrs_prev_chron <- in_df_filt$age_yrs[1]

      out_row$sc_flag <- sc_flag
      
      out_row$c_t_ha_af <- in_df_filt$c_t_ha[2]
      out_row$c_t_ha_af_prev_chron <- in_df_filt$c_t_ha[1]
      
      out_row$c_t_ha_ctrl <- comp_df_filt$c_t_ha[2]
      out_row$c_t_ha_ctrl_prev_chron <- comp_df_filt$c_t_ha[1]
      
      af_c_delt <- out_row$c_t_ha_af - out_row$c_t_ha_af_prev_chron
      ctrl_c_delt <- out_row$c_t_ha_ctrl - out_row$c_t_ha_ctrl_prev_chron
      
      # set control values
      out_row$ctrl_cat <- make_csl(comp_df_filt$af_cat)
      out_row$depth_min_ctrl <- comp_df_filt$depth_min[1]
      out_row$depth_max_ctrl <- comp_df_filt$depth_max[1]
      
      c_t_ha_diff <- af_c_delt - ctrl_c_delt
      
      yrs_diff <- as.numeric(in_df_filt$measurement_year[2]) - 
        as.numeric(in_df_filt$measurement_year[1])
      
      out_row$c_t_ha_yr <- c_t_ha_diff / yrs_diff
      
      out_df <- out_df %>% bind_rows(out_row)
    }
    
    return (out_df)
  }
}

```

Compute delta (AF minus control), using the observed control if available and otherwise the extrapolated t0 control.
```{r compute-delta}

c_df <- c_df %>%
  mutate(
    ctrl_type = case_when(
      !is.na(c_t_ha_ctrl) ~ "observed",
      is.na(c_t_ha_ctrl) & !is.na(c_t_ha_ctrl_extrap) ~ "extrapolated",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    c_t_ha_ctrl = dplyr::coalesce(c_t_ha_ctrl, c_t_ha_ctrl_extrap),
    c_t_ha_delta = c_t_ha_af - c_t_ha_ctrl
  ) %>%
  select(-c_t_ha_ctrl_extrap)

```
